target: Full discoverable public frontend parity; backend and live services excluded

gaps.gap: Raw source is not a runnable standalone bundle.
gaps.frontendWork: Serve the assembled tree; keep the src/service copy and import-rewrite recipe reproducible. Provide a clear preview command.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Initial module 404; corrected leaf and integrated views loaded.

gaps.gap: Fresh-clone build and browser tools are not installed by the clone.
gaps.frontendWork: Bootstrap the pinned build tools for source rebuilds; supply external browser-tool paths for optional capture. Keep preview and audit tooling requirements separate.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: No install/rebuild performed. Portable checksum and capture scripts are included.

gaps.gap: Cached whole-site receipt does not describe the latest source bytes.
gaps.frontendWork: Refresh the full build/receipt before claiming a fresh composed deployment. Existing HH output can be inspected now.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: One unrelated whitespace-only input differs; HH package comparison passes.

gaps.gap: Public page coverage and URLs differ.
gaps.frontendWork: Add Home, donor search, About, Contact, Partners, Login, Forgot Password and public teacher destinations. Decide explicit aliases for the reference `/pages/*.html` URLs while preserving PageRouter's outer routes.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Current leaf parses registration, login, profile, teachers and teacher-detail hashes only.

gaps.gap: Public shell differs: navigation, navy canvas, spacing and typography.
gaps.frontendWork: Match the reference header/footer, active links, expanded mobile menu, forms and page layout. Keep PageRouter diagnostics available outside the site comparison surface.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Equal-width live/local registration screenshots; expanded live menu; integrated iframe capture.

gaps.gap: Inter/Fraunces font files and much of the reference imagery are absent.
gaps.frontendWork: Provide local fonts, page styles and images. Inventory includes homepage tiles, teacher photo, team portraits and partner logos. Verify existing logo/hero assets rather than assuming a matching filename proves matching bytes.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Reference requests/fonts and image dimensions recorded; local font fallback and remote/local byte identity are unverified.

gaps.frontendWork: Build hero, impact display, featured teacher, teacher registration, donation-intent and random-teacher cards. Use deterministic representative values and teacher fixtures.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Populated browser render supersedes earlier text-only loading/zero placeholders. Values are observations, not data-accuracy proof.

gaps.gap: Teacher search is partial: local directory lacks the reference filter form.
gaps.frontendWork: State→county→district→school controls, dependent resets, Find Teachers action and result cards. Add representative match, empty, loading and failure fixtures.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Reference default result region was blank. Filtered live results and no-match behavior were not exercised.

gaps.gap: Public profile presentation and actions are partial.
gaps.frontendWork: Teacher photo, school/location, biography, wishlist handoff and share affordance. Model featured/random/directory selection and missing-profile states with fixtures.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Public featured profile captured; local profiles exist with simplified content and inert wishlist. Wishlist/share outcomes were not activated.

gaps.gap: Registration uses locked identity and omits password/confirmation and real Terms presentation.
gaps.frontendWork: Editable form fields, confirmation UI, school choices, scrollable Terms dialog, consent and client validation. Show mock submission/pending states without production account creation.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Live form and Terms modal inspected; live submission/password rules remain unverified.

gaps.gap: Email/password Login and Forgot Password shells are missing.
gaps.frontendWork: Match credential/reset fields, navigation and representative invalid/pending/success-like local states. Keep them clearly simulated.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Public shells captured. Local demo-login click was not verified; authenticated fixture state was injected to inspect subsequent profile screens.

gaps.frontendWork: Mission/process/team sections, portraits and Terms section, with matching layout.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Public About captured; source asset paths/dimensions listed.

gaps.frontendWork: Fields, social destinations, message-length counter, school-not-listed support path and CAPTCHA placeholder footprint. Include local validation and explicit unsent result states.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Message counter changed after typing; no message sent and no CAPTCHA verification attempted.

gaps.frontendWork: Grouped partner sections/logos and contact navigation.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Public partner sections captured; outbound partner behavior was not tested.

gaps.gap: Mobile and embedded presentation need separate parity checks.
gaps.frontendWork: Compare standalone leaf with the same reference viewport. Separately verify embedded scrolling, reachable controls, menus and focus inside PageRouter.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: The embedded frame is smaller than the browser viewport; surrounding workbench chrome is intentional and should not be mistaken for site styling.

gaps.gap: Complete offline state coverage and accessibility are unverified.
gaps.frontendWork: Preserve useful fixture error/retry/storage/reset behavior; add missing route/form/result states. Check labels, keyboard order, modal focus/close, menu controls, readable errors and reduced motion.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Existing local state controls work in the inspected fixture path. Source attributes and screenshots do not establish full keyboard/accessibility behavior.

gaps.gap: Role-dependent My Page, Logout, Forum and Validation screens are unobserved.
gaps.frontendWork: Inventory intended frontend routes and render role-specific fixtures when reference evidence becomes available.
gaps.evidenceBoundary: Hidden controls were present in anonymous DOM; authenticated screens were not inspected. No public Privacy route was found in the inspected surfaces.

importantLimits: Live forms not submitted; auth and service outcomes excluded
Local actual login click not verified; authenticated synthetic state injected
Directory blank initial results observed; filtered result behavior untested
Whole Bazel receipt stale for unrelated whitespace-only source change; no rebuild
Accessibility partly inspected; full keyboard checks not performed
